items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: The same way maybe, you know, Caruso kept the, you know, the Metropolitan Alphurs.

ctx.x: How do you feel that, um, how do you feel about the gradual erosion of musicians, how do you feel about George, George's dying in the legend of the Hall? Do you feel it affects the Hall very much? It affects me, you know. I certainly, you mean financially? No, I don't, I miss hearing them, you know.
The same way maybe, you know, Caruso kept the, you know, the Metropolitan Alphurs.

Yeah, you know, it went on and got bigger, but I think it's, you know, like, I don't know, there's, you know, like maybe a dozen, you know, really, you know, key musicians. And, you know, people who are, you know, really worth, you know, listening to. And, you know, they can carry a band, they can make a band, you know, soundbite, you know, put Jim with a weak band, you know, and you can carry it, you know, like, Percy can take, you know, a weak band by himself, you know. And just, you know, the difference of…
